definitions.explanation: One of the small engraved tiles used to play mahjong; a standard set has 136 tiles.

examples.japanese: {麻雀|まーじゃん}{牌|ぱい}を{並|なら}べる。
examples.english: to line up the mahjong tiles.

examples.japanese: {麻雀|まーじゃん}{牌|ぱい}を{混|ま}ぜる{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: I can hear the sound of mahjong tiles being shuffled.

examples.japanese: この{麻雀|まーじゃん}{牌|ぱい}は{象牙|ぞうげ}でできた{高級品|こうきゅうひん}だ。
examples.english: These are a high-end set of mahjong tiles made of ivory.

notes:
Composed of {麻雀|まーじゃん} (mahjong) + {牌|ぱい} (tile, playing piece).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {麻雀|まーじゃん}{牌|ぱい}を{混|ま}ぜる: to shuffle mahjong tiles
- {麻雀|まーじゃん}{牌|ぱい}を{積|つ}む: to stack tiles into walls
- {麻雀|まーじゃん}{牌|ぱい}を{捨|す}てる: to discard a tile
